title: Micromouse
spec: STM32F411 · DRV8833 · 4 IR pairs · LSM6DS3 · encoders · USB-C
summary: A maze-solving robot on a single board. V1 failed because the motor driver inputs were put on STM32 pins with no timer behind them, so the motors couldn't be driven with PWM. V2 fixed the pinout, swapped to one DRV8833, and added IR wall sensors, an IMU and wheel encoders.
